notes: A compound verb made from 'ders' (lesson) and 'çalışmak' (to work/study). Do not confuse it with 'ödev yapmak' (to do homework).
Used when studying in general; to specify the subject studied, use 'çalışmak' directly with the subject name (e.g., 'matematik çalışmak' — to study math).
